title: Narrative Designer | Talent Pool
description:
We are ARVORE, a startup in the virtual reality content creation scene.

Based in São Paulo, our studio creates, designs, produces, and develops world-class interactive experiences and games for all current and future high-end immersive platforms, including virtual reality, augmented reality, and mixed reality.

ARVORE is looking to hire a technically adept, creative individual to complement our team. You will have the opportunity to work on innovative immersive and narrative-driven XR experiences, iterating and prototyping with a high level of creative freedom and with the opportunity to guide the direction of some of these endeavors.

Our process emphasizes teamwork, agility, and multidisciplinarity. We are seeking a passionate and self-motivated person with a positive attitude and a genuine team spirit, who enjoys sharing knowledge and is open to learning from others. We embrace problem solvers, those unafraid to experiment and fail, and who are ready to create something new.

JOB DESCRIPTION

ARVORE seeks a creative NARRATIVE DESIGNER to design the narrative elements of our experiences and to champion story within the development process.

When designing a narrative, we all know the golden rule: “show, don’t tell”. In interactive content, we may also add “do, don’t show”. The Narrative Designer must think in actions and interactions, inviting the audience to take actions and immerse their bodies within a story. It is crucial to consider the medium and the user’s body when designing a VR experience.

The ND's role is to ensure that interactions and narrative work seamlessly, considering the specificities of each project.

MAIN CROSS-FUNCTIONAL ACTIVITIES:

  • Conceive, create, and advocate for appropriate narrative features within the team, writing narrative content and ensuring it is embraced by the final product;
  • Develop documents and tools that materialize the project's narrative content, such as emotion curves, beat sheets, synopses, mind maps, screenplays, and similar tools;
  • Create descriptions and backstories for characters, locations, objects, and events, collaborating with the Production Design team and the creative director to develop worldbuilding systems;
  • Collaborate with the Development team to create real-time tools for implementing the narrative content in the experience;
  • Work with the Game Design team and Creative Director to define the flow of events, overseeing dialogues, animations, audio, event timings, props, etc.;
  • Create functional documentation to keep the team and stakeholders informed about the narrative elements;
  • Ensure the project is understandable and cohesive from the user’s perspective, following and reporting on user tests;
  • Produce summaries of the narrative content for distribution, such as festival registrations and pitch decks;
  • Build a repertoire of narrative VR experiences and present new immersive experiences to the team.

MUST HAVE:

  • Exceptional writing ability;
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English;
  • Willingness to observe, absorb, and modify their work per project needs;
  • Strong interpersonal skills for effective communication across disciplines;
  • Previous experience in narrative content creation teams;
  • Constantly seeking to learn new skills and expand their repertoire;
  • Ability to give and receive constructive and creative feedback;
  • Deep understanding of narrative structures, plot beats, emotional progression, and classical storytelling elements;
  • Ability to balance narrative, interaction, and ludology aspects in immersive experiences, integrating story and gameplay;
  • Passion for movies, TV, visual arts, literature, theater, and great stories across media;
  • Experience in scriptwriting for film, TV, or games;
  • Technical or Bachelor of Arts degree in Cinema, Media, Creative Writing, Literature, or equivalent practical experience;
  • Openness to learning new methods and frameworks.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Familiarity with Google G Suite and screenwriting software;
  • Previous experience with VR and AR content;
  • Experience working in a studio or production company;
  • Video game industry experience;
  • A passion for Virtual Reality.

A Diaverum é a empresa líder a nível internacional na prestação de cuidados renais, com foco em melhorar a vida renal dos pacientes - permitindo-lhes viver uma vida plena. A nossa experiência em cuidados renais remonta há mais de 25 anos e temos estado na vanguarda do setor desde então. As nossas operações abrangem atualmente 24 países, com mais de 14.000 funcionários motivados que atendem uma base de pacientes de mais de 40.000 indivíduos.

Atividades:

  1. Fornece terapia de diálise crônica, incluindo, mas não se limitando à formulação de um plano de diálise com ultra filtração, iniciando a diálise através de vários acessos, cumprindo as medidas de segurança e monitorando os sinais vitais do paciente aplicáveis aos pacientes com insuficiência renal crônica de acordo com o Plano de Cuidados.
  2. Prepara e administra medicamentos, fluido terapia ou outros tratamentos apropriados por prescrição médica e realiza as respectivas documentações no prontuário do paciente.
  3. Analisa dados do paciente; avalia e monitoriza o status dos acessos vasculares, revisa resultados laboratoriais, avaliações de pacientes e relata quaisquer alterações ou anormalidades relevantes ao médico plantonista.
  4. Monitoriza o sistema de tratamento de água de diálise para uso de acordo com os procedimentos estabelecidos.
  5. Montar e verificar o funcionamento dos aparelhos de hemodiálise, garantindo que todos os dispositivos estejam limpos, funcionais e calibrados.
  6. Avaliar as condições clínicas do paciente antes e após a sessão, incluindo sinais vitais e acesso vascular.
  7. Observar continuamente os sinais vitais e os parâmetros do aparelho durante a hemodiálise para garantir a eficácia e a segurança do tratamento, ajustar o fluxo sanguíneo e os parâmetros da máquina conforme necessário.
  8. Realizar uma avaliação inicial detalhada, coletando informações sobre sintomas, histórico médico e alterações recentes no estado de saúde.
  9. Inspecionar e cuidar do acesso vascular para prevenir infecções e complicações, instruir o paciente sobre cuidados domiciliares com o acesso.
  10. Manter registros detalhados sobre o tratamento, incluindo dados vitais, parâmetros da máquina, e qualquer evento adverso. Assegurar que a documentação seja completa e precisa.
  11. Relatar alterações no estado do paciente e resultados das sessões à equipe médica e outros profissionais de saúde envolvidos no cuidado.
  12. Assegurar que todos os procedimentos sejam realizados de acordo com as normas e protocolos estabelecidos pela Diaverum Brasil.
  13. Fornece educação continuada ao paciente e respectivo prestador de cuidados.
  14. Participa proativamente em programas de melhoria de qualidade.

Requisitos:

  1. Graduação em Enfermagem;
  2. Registro no COREN;
  3. Experiência em procedimentos hospitalares e Hemodiálise;
  4. Especialização em Nefrologia (desejável).

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective human intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform, launched and powered by Toloka, connects domain experts with cutting‑edge AI projects from innovative tech clients. Our mission is to unlock the potential of GenAI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for curious and intellectually proactive contributors, the kind of person who double‑checks assumptions and plays devil’s advocate. Are you comfortable with ambiguity and complexity? Does an async, remote, flexible opportunity sound exciting? Would you like to learn how modern AI systems are tested and evaluated?

  • Analysts, researchers, or consultants with strong critical thinking skills
  • Students (senior undergrads / grad students) looking for an intellectually interesting gig
  • People open to a part‑time and non‑permanent opportunity

About the Project

We’re on the hunt for QAs for autonomous AI agents for a new project focused on validating and improving complex task structures, policy logic, and agent evaluation frameworks. Throughout the project, you’ll have to balance quality assurance, research, and logical problem‑solving. This project opportunity is ideal for people who enjoy looking at systems holistically and thinking through scenarios, implications, and edge cases.

You do not need a coding background, but you must be curious, intellectually rigorous, and capable of evaluating the soundness and consistency of complex setups. If you’ve ever excelled in things like consulting, CHGK, Olympiads, case solving, or systems thinking — you might be a great fit.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Reviewing evaluation tasks and scenarios for logic, completeness, and realism
  • Identifying inconsistencies, missing assumptions, or unclear decision points
  • Helping define clear expected behaviors (gold standards) for AI agents
  • Annotating cause‑effect relationships, reasoning paths, and plausible alternatives
  • Thinking through complex systems and policies as a human would to ensure agents are tested properly
  • Working closely with QA, writers, or developers to suggest refinements or edge case coverage

How to Get Started

Apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to a project aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. Shape the future of AI while building tools that benefit everyone.

Requirements

  • Excellent analytical thinking: Can reason about complex systems, scenarios, and logical implications
  • Strong attention to detail: Can spot contradictions, ambiguities, and vague requirements
  • Familiarity with structured data formats: Can read, not necessarily write JSON/YAML
  • Ability to assess scenarios holistically: What’s missing, what’s unrealistic, what might break?
  • Good communication and clear writing (in English) to document your findings.

We also value applicants who have:

  • Experience with policy evaluation, logic puzzles, case studies, or structured scenario design
  • Background in consulting, academia, olympiads (e.g. logic/math/informatics), or research
  • Exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI‑generated content
  • Familiarity with QA or test‑case thinking (edge cases, failure modes, "what could go wrong")
  • Some understanding of how scoring or evaluation works in agent testing (precision, coverage, etc.)

Benefits

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $17/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs
  • Take part in a flexible, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
  • Participate in an advanced AI project and gain valuable experience to enhance your portfolio

title: Static Mechanical Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
Static Mechanical Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Full relocation to Saudi Arabia – permanent full-time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview: We are seeking a Plant Corrosion Engineer to join the Riyas Engineering Division (RNGLFD) which is part of the Riyas NGL Fractionation Dept (RNGLFD).

RNGLFD is responsible for two trains, each designed to process 255 MBOD (242.25 MBCD). Each train will include fractionation units, C3 & C4 treatment, C3 & C4 dehydration and propane refrigeration. The common facilities will include feed and product surge storage, chemicals storage and utilities including, but not limited to, steam and condensate recovery systems, utility water, plant, instrument air and nitrogen systems, machinery cooling water, drainage and flare systems. Some of the systems (e.g., steam headers, flare headers, product storage) have been pre-invested for the future train.

Your primary role will be to implement, support and continually improve RNGLFP inspection corrosion management programs and provide consolatory advice in materials, ensuring cost effective material selection and corrosion mitigation strategies, which will ensure mechanical integrity of the materials, applied on all plant assets including equipment and piping through their life cycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement corrosion management program and on-stream monitoring and Conduct risk-based inspection based on API-580 methodology.
  • Review and approve recommended solutions for coating failures and cathodic protection and participate in HAZOP review sessions and ensure that all issues are addressed.
  • Manage water treatment program and recommend solutions to overcome challenges and review design packages and validate materials selection based on current code and standards.
  • Validate corrosion controls corrosion controls, corrosion (CCD), corrosion loops and corrosion damage mechanisms frequently.
  • Assess FEED composition changes and approve recommended solution to assure assets integrity.
  • Develop scope and description of technology items, and lead field implementation.
  • Develop and transfer knowledge about use of coating, Cathodic protection (CP), corrosion inhibitors and other corrosion controls and best practices.
  • Extract data and draw conclusions from Corrosion Monitoring Technologies, and troubleshoot corrosion problems and address root causes.
  • Perform the regular review and update on the plants Integrity Operating Windows (IOW) and Corrosion loops drawings shall be updated by adding emerging damage mechanisms or removing damage mechanisms because of plant upgrades.
  • Adjust and modify inspection practices and programs shall be reflected based on such modifications and perform special studies in corrosion control. Evaluates data as to scope, impact and long-range cost effectiveness on existing and new projects.
  • Review operations and monitoring activities to identify needed system modifications or procedural changes associated with corrosion control with conduct corrosion mitigation and integrity review to optimize the inspection and corrosion programs and maintain assets integrity.

Qualification Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, preferably in mechanical engineer.
  • 15 years' experience processing in Oil/Gas Industry.
  • Demonstrate experience in material science and metrology, different NDT technology and their applications and knowledge in engineering aspect of welding.
  • Strong Knowledge of international standards and codes NACE, ASME, API and ASTM especially inspection and corrosion standards such as API-571, API-580, API-570 and API-510.
  • Valid NACE Specialist Certification or NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist or combination of NACE Corrosion Technologist, API-571 and NACE CP level II.

title: Senior Growth Marketing Analyst (PLG)
description:
We are a global technology company specializing in digital applications and security. Our platform helps companies operate more agilely, reducing response times and increasing the reliability of their systems.

At Azion, our purpose is to simplify application development and transform the future with cutting-edge technology. Here, you will have the chance to develop in an innovative environment, alongside a high-performance team, working on real challenges and creating solutions that make a difference.

About the position

We are looking for a Senior Growth Marketing Analyst to join our Marketing & Growth team in our São Paulo office. As part of the Marketing & Growth team, the successful candidate will be responsible for designing, executing, and optimizing product-led growth strategies across our self-serve funnel—from acquisition and activation to monetization and retention.

You will own the experimentation roadmap, build lifecycle and in-product experiences that drive the “aha” moment and habit formation, define and operationalize PQLs, and partner closely with Product Engineering, Data, and Sales to accelerate revenue from our self-serve and product-qualified motions.

Your Impact

  • Own self-serve funnel KPIs (signup → activation → PQL → paid → retention) and deliver quarter-over-quarter improvements aligned to our plans and a clear North Star metric;
  • Build and run a rigorous experimentation program across website, onboarding, in-app paywalls, and pricing/packaging; translate results into shipped improvements;
  • Design and launch lifecycle programs (email, in-app, push) that guide users to activation, expand adoption, and reduce churn, leveraging segmentation and personalization;
  • Define PQL scoring and routing; implement lead capture, intent signals, and sales handoff processes with RevOps to enable product-led sales;
  • Partner with Product Engineering and Data to instrument analytics, create dashboards, and socialize insights that inform roadmap, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.

What You’ll Bring

  • Solid experience in B2B SaaS growth/marketing with 2–3+ years driving PLG at scale; proven impact on activation, conversion, and net revenue retention;
  • Strong analytical toolkit: proficiency in SQL and experimentation analysis; comfort with cohort/retention modeling, LTV/CAC, payback, and pricing/packaging tradeoffs;
  • Hands‑on with PLG tooling: product analytics (Amplitude/Mixpanel), CDP (Segment), marketing automation (HubSpot/Braze/Customer.io), A/B testing (Optimizely/LaunchDarkly), and web analytics (GA4/Tag Manager);
  • Excellent product sense and messaging skills; can craft crisp in-product copy and lifecycle communications grounded in user research and JTBD frameworks;
  • High‑ownership, cross‑functional collaborator who can prioritize ruthlessly, manage a backlog, and influence without authority in a fast‑paced environment.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with freemium or usage-based models, paywall design, and pricing experimentation;
  • Familiarity with modeling PQLs using scoring/ML and building referral or viral loops that compound growth.

Benefits & Azion Way of Life

  • CLT hiring model;
  • Health and dental plan;
  • Flexible VR and VA (Flash Card), including during vacation periods;
  • Transport voucher without payroll deduction;
  • Mobility allowance (additional amount for travel);
  • Freestyle (incentive to customize the workstation);
  • Stock options (according to policy);
  • Birthday day off;
  • TotalPass;
  • Flexible working hours (really flexible);
  • Nomad Program to work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year (according to policy);
  • Annual international exchange program.

FlexWork Model

We offer a FlexWork model that prioritizes acculturation and collaboration. For the first three months, you will work on‑site in the local office, an essential step in building solid relationships and a genuine connection with our values and culture. We believe that this initial immersion not only strengthens the team, but also boosts creativity and innovation.

After this period, you will have the possibility to apply for the hybrid model, working on‑site at least three times a week. This approach balances interaction in person and autonomy, creating a dynamic and productive working environment.

At Azion, all applications are welcome, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, pregnancy, disability, ethnicity, color, country of origin, or religion. We believe that an inclusive environment contributes to our success and that respect is present in all our relationships.

Come and join our team! We look forward to getting to know you and walking a path of success in technology together!

description:
Teltonika IoT Solutions Brazil is a representative branch of Teltonika IoT Group, which has been creating and manufacturing Internet of Things (IoT) for over 20 years. From connected vehicles to networking, we seek our solutions to be used globally and become an indispensable part of any business. By setting new trends, we inspire our partners to change the world and use the most advanced technologies in the market.

We are constantly growing and looking for an organized IoT Solutions Engineering Specialist to join our team in São Paulo, SP .

Responsibilities

  • Work with various Teltonika Telematics-manufactured GNSS tracking devices that embed technologies such as Bluetooth, CANbus, RS232/RS485, and 1-Wire
  • Propose different ways on how to incorporate our devices for various use cases
  • Be responsible for arranging technical tasks for custom development projects and coordinating solution release to clients
  • Troubleshoot, provide assistance, and consult clients via a dedicated ticketing system or online meetings/chats if they are needed
  • Communicate with global international corporations that provide car sharing, rental, fleet management solutions and various other companies from different vehicle telematics fields
  • Cooperate with R&D, quality assurance and project management teams to ensure the maintenance of the projects and that solutions reach the clients on time
  • Have an opportunity to go on business trips to visit clients and help them directly implement Teltonika devices into their business use cases
  • Guide colleagues and customers by preparing wiki documentation or training

What we expect of you

  • Great communication skills, are capable of fluently speaking and writing in English (proficiency in other languages will be considered as an advantage)
  • Telecommunications, electronics, informatics, engineering education or previous work experience in technical or engineering fields
  • Passion for providing help to others, caring, willing to grow and enrich your technological know-how
  • Analytical and creative thinking and mindset for problem-solving and troubleshooting
  • Understanding or basic knowledge of telecommunication technologies (2G, GPRS, 3G, 4G), CANbus, BLE
  • Knowledge or work experience working with ticketing-based platforms (Jira, GitLab, OpenProject, ServiceDesk) (this will be considered as an advantage)
  • Experience in customer service (this will be considered as an advantage)

What we offer

  • Salary : We appreciate everyone's efforts and experiences, so we offer an attractive salary matching your skillset and field expertise.
  • Career : Great opportunities to grow in a strong and rapidly expanding company.
  • Work model : Hybrid (4 days in person and one remote)
  • Catering benefits : Cartão Caju (Vale Refeição of R$35 per working days + Saldo Livre of R$750 monthly + R$09 per working day), coffee and fruits provided in the office;
  • Health and Well-being Benefits : TotalPass, SESC membership, healthcare, dental care, and life insurance.
  • Teambuilding : regular office celebrations and events that help us to get to know each other better.
  • Caring and supportive team : we constantly seek for our employees to have better leadership while regularly sending our managers to external coaching sessions, conducting annual employee engagement surveys, and other management and HRD initiatives to help our employees overcome bottlenecks and challenges.

Teltonika aspires to become one of the global leaders in providing unique IoT solutions that contribute to making people’s lives easier. Since 1998, we have gained considerable experience and competence in electronics development and production. Today, our areas of expertise include telematics, networking, telemedicine, EV charging, and electronics manufacturing. While proactively searching for new ideas and ways to create more value for our clients, we also hope to create a better future for our employees and the communities we operate in. Our organizational culture is based on mutual trust and respect as well as creating synergy with our employees and clients.

O setor encontra-se no subsolo, com acesso do colaborador ao posto de trabalho por elevadores e escadas rolantes e deslocamento pelas áreas operacionais do aeroporto.

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, deambulação por toda extensão do aeroporto para o atendimento do voo, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico para limpeza e deslocamento da escada da aeronave.

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, eventualmente existe a necessidade de esforço físico e deambulação entre áreas administrativas e operacionais do aeroporto.

O Refrigerentes do Triangulo LTDA está em busca de novos talentos para fazer parte da nossa equipe da indústria de Rio Verde/GO.

Habilidade técnica: É fundamental ter um bom entendimento de como as máquinas funcionam. Isso inclui saber ligar e desligar equipamentos, ajustar configurações e, muitas vezes, fazer pequenas manutenções preventivas.

Capacidade de resolver problemas: Se a máquina travar, se o rótulo sair torto ou se houver qualquer outro problema, o operador precisa ser capaz de diagnosticar a falha rapidamente e encontrar uma solução.

Conhecimento de segurança: A indústria de alimentos e bebidas tem normas de segurança muito rigorosas. O operador precisa saber e seguir todas elas, especialmente no manuseio de equipamentos e substâncias químicas usadas na limpeza e higienização.

Trabalho em equipe: Muitas vezes, o operador trabalha em conjunto com outros profissionais, como técnicos de manutenção e inspetores de qualidade. A comunicação eficaz é essencial para garantir um fluxo de trabalho suave.

Operar e monitorar equipamentos: A principal tarefa é operar as máquinas que realizam o envase, rotulagem e embalagem dos refrigerantes. Isso inclui configurar as máquinas, ajustar a velocidade e garantir que funcionem corretamente durante todo o turno.

Alimentar a linha de produção: O operador é responsável por alimentar as máquinas com matérias-primas e componentes, como garrafas, rótulos e tampas, para garantir o fluxo contínuo da produção.

Manutenção de rotina: Realizar limpezas, lubrificações e outras pequenas manutenções para garantir o bom funcionamento do equipamento.

Registro de dados: Anotar informações sobre a produção, como a quantidade de garrafas produzidas, os materiais usados e o tempo de inatividade da máquina.

Garantir a segurança: Seguir os protocolos de segurança para evitar acidentes e contaminação do produto.

The Senior Manager translates global brand direction into Brazil‑first strategies, collaborating deeply with cross‑functional partners, and guiding the team in producing compelling content that captures attention, drives conversation, and fuels measurable growth.

This is a highly visible, fast‑moving role requiring a creative strategist, disciplined operator, and strong people leader who can inspire talent, influence stakeholders, and elevate the brand in one of HBO’s most important markets, and let’s face it… home of the BEST FANS IN THE WORLD. #ComeToBrazil

  • Lead the development and execution of Brazil’s social media strategy, ensuring alignment with local marketing priorities, regional directives, and global brand standards.

  • Own the social performance measurement framework, partnering with Social Media Analysts & agency partners to interpret data, generate actionable insights, and guide continuous optimization across platforms.

  • Lead relationships with social media agencies and external partners, ensuring seamless coordination, timely deliverables, and high‑quality creative output.
  • Collaborate with Paid Media teams on paid social strategy, providing guidance on creative assets, audience priorities, and measurement.
  • Ensure operational excellence across workflows, processes, and publishing systems, improving efficiency and establishing best practices for the Brazil team and broader region.
  • Represent Brazil’s social needs and insights in international alignment meetings, advocating for market‑specific strategies and opportunities across global teams.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, or a related field
  • Fluency in English (Spanish a plus)
  • Solid experience in social media, preferably in entertainment or agency settings
  • Proficiency with social media tools (e.g., Hootsuite, Sprout Social) and analytics platforms

  • Skilled in creating reports and presenting insights

title: UGC Video Editor
description:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Why This Role Matters

Authenticity, pacing, and performance are your playground. As a UGC Video Editor, you are the bridge between a raw influencer review and a profitable ad campaign. You understand that in 2026, a polished cinematic commercial often loses to a well-edited, authentic-looking TikTok shot on an iPhone.

Your job is to craft the narrative, nail the hook, and apply the specific editing language of the internet (captions, sounds, pacing) to drive sales. If you are obsessed with why some videos go viral and others flop, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  • Transform Raw Assets into Ads
    • Ingest raw footage from creators and influencers (testimonials, unboxings, demos) and craft them into cohesive direct-response video ads.
    • Structure edits around proven marketing frameworks (Hook → Problem → Solution → Social Proof → CTA).
    • Ensure the “vibe” feels native to the platform (TikTok/Reels/Shorts), avoiding the “over-produced” look that kills engagement.
  • Master the “Hook”
    • Create multiple variations of the first 3 seconds of every video to test what grabs attention best.
    • Utilize visual disruption, sound effects, and trending audio to prevent viewers from scrolling past.
  • Apply Native Visuals
    • Implement platform-native text styles, dynamic captions (e.g., Alex Hormozi style), emojis, and stickers that enhance the storytelling without looking cluttered.
    • Clean up audio levels and apply basic color correction to ensure mobile viewing quality.
  • Iterate at Speed
    • Produce high volumes of iterations (e.g., same body, different hook; same hook, different music) to feed our testing machine.
    • Respond quickly to data feedback from the media buying team (e.g., “Shorten the intro,” “Make the text bigger”).

Who You Are

  • A Social Media Native
    • 1–3 years of experience editing UGC or social-first content (Agency or Freelance).
    • You understand the “visual language” of TikTok and Instagram. You know what trending fonts, sounds, and cuts are working right now.
  • Technically Proficient
    • Expert proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro is required for our agency workflow.
    • Familiarity with CapCut features/styles and how to replicate them in Premiere is a massive plus.
    • Basic skills in After Effects or Photoshop for static asset integration.
  • A Storyteller
    • You can take 20 minutes of rambling raw footage and cut it down to a sharp, persuasive 30-second story.
    • You have a good sense of rhythm and comedic timing.
  • Fast & Adaptable
    • You are comfortable with high-volume workflows. You can churn out quality edits quickly.
    • You don’t get attached to your cuts—you iterate based on what the data says.
  • Excellent Communicator
    • Strong English proficiency is required. You can interpret creative briefs accurately and collaborate with producers remotely.

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: Influence the creative strategy of major DTC brands and sharpen your direct-response marketing skills.
  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one viral hook at a time.

Somos uma indústria especializada em soluções tecnológicas para a manutenção preditiva de ativos industriais. O objetivo da nossa solução é transformar a indústria, tornando-a mais segura e mais produtiva do que ontem. Além disso, reconhecemos e valorizamos a diversidade de habilidades e experiências que cada pessoa possui. Nosso compromisso é garantir oportunidades igualitárias para todos os talentos, respeitando a singularidade de cada indivíduo e promovendo um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor.

Além disso, temos orgulho de possuir as certificações das ISOs 9001, 27001, 27017, 27018, 27701. Por meio delas, promovemos a organização e a estrutura de nossos processos, resultando em um ambiente de trabalho mais organizado e eficiente.

Conheça mais sobre nós, visite nosso site.

title: Mecânico de Manutenção
description:
Overview

Autoneum é líder mundial na gestão acústica e térmica de veículos. A empresa desenvolve e produz componentes e sistemas multifuncionais e leves para o chão interior e o compartimento do motor, bem como para a parte inferior da carroçaria. Os clientes incluem quase todos os fabricantes de automóveis na Europa, América do Norte e do Sul, Ásia e África. A Autoneum opera 67 instalações de produção e emprega cerca de 16 600 pessoas em todo o mundo. A empresa, com sede em Winterthur, Suíça, está cotada na SIX Swiss Exchange (símbolo AUTN).

Cargo e Local de Trabalho

Cargo: Mecânico de Manutenção.

Área de atuação: Manutenção.

Local de trabalho: Jardim Guairacá, São Paulo - SP - Presencial.

Responsabilidades

  • Localizar defeitos e identificar causas através de testes e observações, efetuando desmontagem parcial ou total dos equipamentos e ou máquinas, substituindo ou consertando peças e ou componentes danificados e ou defeituosos, tais como: rolamentos, correias, eixos, retentores, válvulas, gaxetas, engrenagens, acessórios e outros, montando o equipamento e verificando seu perfeito funcionamento.
  • Interpretar e criar esquemas de circuitos hidráulicos e/ou pneumáticos, mantendo os registros atualizados, informando as modificações efetuadas ou a efetuar.
  • Utilizar chaves de fenda, estrela, fixa, soquete, alicates, paquímetros, micrômetro, tacômetro e outras ferramentas e equipamentos, mantendo sua guarda e conservação.
  • Requisitar e retirar junto aos almoxarifados, materiais, ferramentas, equipamentos, instrumentos etc., para uso na execução dos serviços.
  • Transmitir ao superior imediato os problemas e irregularidades observadas no funcionamento de máquinas e equipamentos; na impossibilidade, registrar nas fichas de máquinas e ou livro apropriado as ocorrências sucedidas.
  • Diagnosticar as falhas nas máquinas e equipamentos, analisando juntamente com o Operador, na busca e localização do defeito ou origem do mau funcionamento, reduzindo o tempo de reparação ou restauração, assegurando pleno funcionamento das máquinas e equipamentos.
  • Anotar em impressos apropriados, dados relativos a serviços tais como: tipos de defeitos, soluções, modificações, identificação de peças, horas trabalhadas, quantidade de materiais, tipo de manutenção (preventiva ou corretiva), etc.

Requisitos mandatórios

  • Escolaridade: curso técnico completo;
  • Experiência: atuação prévia com máquinas hidráulicas e equipamentos em ambiente de Manutenção;
  • Jornada de trabalho: flexibilidade para atuar em qualquer turno (período matutino, vespertino e noturno).
  • Ferramentas de análises e soluções de problemas, principalmente 5 Porquês;
  • Treinamentos de NRs, sobretudo NR 35 - Trabalho em Altura.

Competências comportamentais

  • Proatividade;
  • Boa comunicação;
  • Visão estratégica de oportunidades de melhoria contínua e gestão de mudanças.

Você pode se destacar se tiver:

  • Treinamento de NR 34 - Trabalho a Quente;
  • Treinamento de NR 33 - Trabalho em Espaço Confinado;
  • Treinamento de NR 11 - Operação de Empilhadeira;
  • Treinamento de NR 18 - Operação de Plataforma Elevatória;
  • Conhecimentos em TPM – Manutenção Produtiva Total.

Realizar manutenções mecânicas em máquinas agrícolas, abrangendo desde a análise de ordens de serviço até a condução de veículos leves. Destacando‑se na localização e diagnóstico sensitivo, preventivo e corretivo de defeitos, desmontagem e montagem de conjuntos, e execução de ajustes em freios, cubo, câmbio, motor, embreagem, além de intervenções em mecânica de precisão. Demonstrar habilidades na solução de problemas em diferentes níveis de complexidade, usando as ferramentas e softwares de diagnósticos, julgando custo/benefício e registrando materiais utilizados. Contribuir para a excelência operacional, organizando ferramentas, realizando lavagem e descarte adequado de materiais, promovendo eficiência e garantindo a satisfação do cliente interno.

Responsabilidades

  • Examinar ordens de serviço para realizar a manutenção mecânica necessária, identificando e corrigindo defeitos em maquinário e implementos agrícolas.
  • Localizar e diagnosticar defeitos mecânicos em diferentes níveis de complexidade, usando os softwares de diagnóstico, examinando o funcionamento ou diretamente a peça defeituosa, visando providenciar a recuperação adequada.
  • Desmontar total ou parcialmente conjuntos a serem reparados, seguindo as especificações do equipamento, utilizando ferramentas apropriadas para consertar ou substituir peças defeituosas.
  • Efetuar a montagem do conjunto reparado, ajustando as peças com instrumentos específicos para devolver a máquina às condições ideais de funcionamento.
  • Executar e seguir um programa de lubrificação preventiva e corretiva para máquinas e implementos agrícolas sempre que necessário, baseado nas especificações do fabricante e nas condições operacionais.
  • Efetuar o alinhamento, calibragem do pneu quando necessário, a fim de evitar desgastes prematuros dos pneus.
  • Aplicar diferentes tipos de lubrificantes, óleos e graxas sempre que necessário, utilizando métodos adequados para assegurar a lubrificação correta de partes móveis e componentes.
  • Realizar inspeções visuais e táteis para identificar desgastes, vazamentos ou sinais de problemas nos equipamentos sempre que necessário, reportando ao departamento de manutenção quando necessário.
  • Executar soldagem em peças metálicas quando necessários, utilizando técnicas adequadas como MIG, TIG ou eletrodo revestido, garantindo a aderência e resistência necessárias.
  • Investigar e diagnosticar problemas, propondo soluções e efetuando correções em veículos, máquinas agrícolas e pesadas, demonstrando habilidades tanto em serviços de menor quanto maior complexidade.
  • Realizar ajustes intermediários em freios, cubo, câmbio, motor e embreagem, voltados para a mecânica pesada, assim como ajustes finos na mecânica de precisão e em componentes complexos.
  • Conduzir veículos leves (caminhonetes, carros pequenos) conforme necessário, seguindo as regras de trânsito para transporte de pessoas, materiais e/ou realização de serviços em trajetos determinados.
  • Verificar o resultado do trabalho executado, certificando-se de que os veículos e máquinas estão em condições ideais de utilização.
  • Julgar o custo/benefício dos serviços a serem executados, analisando recursos internos, prazos e conhecimento especializado, encaminhando para manutenção terceirizada, se necessário.
  • Registrar os materiais utilizados nos serviços e encaminhá-los ao superior imediato para providenciar a compra, evitando atrasos e interrupções nos serviços.
  • Executar lavagem e organização das ferramentas e peças utilizadas, bem como o descarte adequado de materiais e resíduos provenientes da execução dos serviços.
  • Realizar treinamentos técnicos básicos para colaboradores novos e redistribuir serviços para outros mecânicos, considerando a complexidade das tarefas.
  • Participar ativamente da Semana Interna de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalho Rural (SIPATR), em conformidade com as normas regulamentadoras aplicáveis ao setor agrícola.
  • Participar de programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento para aprimorar as habilidades e conhecimentos relacionados às atividades do setor.
  • Colaborar com outros membros da equipe de campo e seguir as instruções do superior imediato para garantir a eficiência e qualidade das operações da Hervalense.
  • Desenvolver outras atividades correlatas à sua função, de acordo com as solicitações de seus superiores.
  • Zelar pelos bens patrimoniais, preservando os equipamentos, mobiliários e demais recursos disponibilizados pela Hervalense.

title: World Bank Announces Senior Social Development Specialist Vacancy in Brazil
description:
World Bank Announces Senior Social Development Specialist Vacancy in Brazil

Brasília, Brazil — The World Bank Group has opened applications for a Senior Social Development Specialist position based in Brasília , strengthening its commitment to social inclusion, environmental and social risk management, and sustainable development across Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) . The role is offered under local recruitment with a three-year term , and applications close on February 17, 2026 .

This senior-level position sits within the World Bank’s Social Development sector and plays a critical role in implementing the institution’s Environmental and Social Framework (ESF) across investment projects in Brazil.

A Strategic Role at the Heart of Social Inclusion and Risk Management

Brazil remains central to the World Bank’s work in the LAC region, where persistent inequality, climate vulnerability, and infrastructure gaps continue to challenge inclusive growth. The Senior Social Development Specialist will serve as a core advisor to World Bank task teams , ensuring that projects are socially inclusive, compliant with ESF standards, and responsive to the needs of vulnerable communities.

The role is housed within the SLCM2 ESF Unit , covering the Southern Country Management Units of the region, and reports directly to the Practice Manager based in Washington, DC.

Focus Areas: From Indigenous Peoples to Labor and Community Safety

The selected specialist will lead social risk management across complex, high-impact investment projects, with responsibilities spanning the entire project lifecycle.

Key focus areas include:

  • Involuntary resettlement and livelihood restoration
  • Indigenous Peoples and traditional community protections
  • Labor and working conditions
  • Stakeholder engagement and grievance redress mechanisms
  • Gender-based violence and social risks linked to labor influx
  • Inclusion of vulnerable and marginalized groups

The role also involves mentoring junior specialists, supporting government counterparts, and contributing to capacity building efforts that strengthen national systems in Brazil.

Core Responsibilities

The Senior Social Development Specialist will:

  • Integrate ESF requirements into project design, appraisal, and implementation
  • Review and guide social risk instruments such as Resettlement Plans, Indigenous Peoples Plans, Labor Management Procedures, and Stakeholder Engagement Plans
  • Advise on public consultation, disclosure, and grievance mechanisms
  • Contribute to key World Bank operational documents, including project appraisals and implementation reports
  • Support portfolio reviews and briefings for World Bank management
  • Lead analytical and advisory work on social inclusion and social risk management in Brazil

Who the World Bank Is Looking For

This role is designed for highly experienced professionals with strong field exposure and the ability to operate in complex, high-pressure environments.

Minimum requirements include:

  • Master’s degree in social sciences or related disciplines
  • At least 8 years of professional experience in environmental and social risk management aligned with ESF / ESS1–ESS10
  • Hands‑on experience with large infrastructure or extractive sector projects
  • Strong background in stakeholder engagement and participatory processes
  • Proven ability to work with governments, civil society, and affected communities
  • Fluency in both English and Portuguese
  • Willingness to travel extensively across Brazil, including remote areas

Experience working with the World Bank or other multilateral development banks is highly valued.

Why This Role Matters

This position offers a unique opportunity to shape how major development investments affect people’s lives on the ground. By embedding social inclusion, transparency, and accountability into projects, the Senior Social Development Specialist helps ensure that development in Brazil is equitable, resilient, and people-centered .

Vaga para Product Owner Sênior Descrição

Estamos em busca de um(a) Product Owner Sênior para atuar como peça-chave na gestão tática e operacional dos nossos produtos. Buscamos um(a) profissional com sólida experiência em metodologias ágeis, capaz de traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e funcionais. Você será responsável por maximizar o valor entregue pelo time de engenharia, garantindo um backlog refinado, priorizado e alinhado aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa, assegurando a qualidade e a previsibilidade das entregas.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Gestão e Priorização de Backlog: Gerenciar o Product Backlog, garantindo que os itens estejam priorizados, detalhados e prontos para desenvolvimento, gerenciando mudanças de escopo e demandas.
  • Refinamento e Especificação: Escrever User Stories, épicos e critérios de aceitação com clareza, aplicando boas práticas de definição de Definition of Ready (DoR) e Definition of Done (DoD).
  • Rituais Ágeis: Liderar e participar ativamente das cerimônias do Scrum (Refinamento, Planning, Daily, Sprint Review e Retrospectiva), assegurando a execução integral dos rituais.
  • Validação e Qualidade: Validar e homologar as entregas do time de desenvolvimento, garantindo que as features atendam aos requisitos de negócio e funcionais solicitados, reduzindo retrabalho.
  • Acompanhamento de Métricas: Monitorar métricas ágeis (velocity, throughput, lead time) e relatórios (Burndown/Burnup) para garantir a previsibilidade e saúde das sprints.
  • Interface Negócio-Técnica: Atuar como ponte entre stakeholders e o time de engenharia, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções funcionais e participando do processo de Product Discovery.
  • Documentação: Manter a documentação do produto e das entregas de cada sprint atualizada e organizada no Confluence e outras ferramentas.
  • Apoio ao Design: Colaborar na leitura e validação de protótipos e fluxos (Figma, Miro), apoiando testes de usabilidade e definição de jornadas de usuário.

Requisitos

  • Metodologias Ágeis: Conhecimento sólido em Scrum e Kanban, com domínio do papel de PO, seus artefatos e rituais.
  • Engenharia de Requisitos: Pleno domínio das práticas de elicitação e especificação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais.
  • Métricas: Experiência no acompanhamento e análise de métricas ágeis e relatórios de sprint.
  • Visão Técnica: Capacidade de leitura e entendimento técnico (nível conceitual) para dialogar com engenharia e entender processos de CI/CD e ambientes.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Ensino Superior completo em Tecnologia, Administração, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas (Obrigatório).
  • Idiomas: Inglês nível Intermediário (domínio e fluência).

Ferramentas e Conceitos Adicionais

  • Gestão de Backlog: Domínio de Jira Software e Confluence Boards (ou ferramentas similares como Rally/VersionOne).
  • Documentação: Experiência com Confluence, Google Drive, Google Docs e diagramação (Draw.io, Lucidchart).
  • Métricas: Uso de Jira Reports, Azure DevOps Analytics e Excel/Google Sheets para análise de dados.
  • Colaboração e Design: Familiaridade com Figma (leitura/validação), FigJam, Miro ou Whimsical.
  • Integração Técnica: Noções de visualização em GitHub/GitLab e pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Comunicação: Uso fluente de Slack, Discord e Google Meet.

Diferenciais (Qualificações Desejáveis)

  • Certificações ágeis reconhecidas, como CSPO (Certified Scrum Product Owner) ou PSPO (Professional Scrum Product Owner).
  • Conhecimento aprofundado dos processos de Engenharia de Software.
  • Experiência prévia como Product Owner ou Analista de Negócios em empresas de plataforma SaaS.

Competências

  • Comunicação Assertiva: Capacidade de comunicação clara e objetiva, tanto verbal quanto escrita, facilitando o entendimento entre áreas distintas.
  • Organização: Excelência na organização e gestão de prioridades em um ambiente dinâmico.
  • Negociação: Habilidade para negociar prazos e escopos com stakeholders e time técnico.
  • Visão Crítica e Analítica: Pensamento orientado a dados e foco em resultados para tomada de decisão.
  • Colaboração: Facilidade para trabalhar com times multidisciplinares e proatividade para resolver impedimentos.
  • Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de lidar com mudanças de cenário e requisitos com resiliência.

Required Skills :

  • Fluent at the business level for English , Spanish, and Portuguese; required
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Integrity, professionalism, and a commitment to confidentiality
  • Proficiency with or the ability to quickly learn the organizations HRIS and talent management systems
  • Detailed knowledge of payroll processes

Preferred Skills :

  • All new hires will be required to successfully complete and pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check in compliance with NIST 800-171

Guest engagement is at the heart of this role — we want every photo session to be fun, relaxed, and memorable.
  • In addition to photography duties, you’ll support the PhotoStudio program by encouraging bookings and explaining the services offered. You’ll also assist in the photo gallery and shop, helping guests select and purchase their images while promoting additional products and services. Sales skills and product knowledge are essential, as is maintaining a clean, organized, and well‑stocked retail space.
  • You’ll be responsible for the care and proper use of company‑issued equipment, ensuring everything is maintained to the highest standards. Professional appearance is also important, wearing the correct uniform, name badge, and Cruise pin, along with excellent personal grooming, is expected at all times.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

  • Previous experience as a cruise photographer highly desirable.
  • Degree in photography preferred, but most types of college certificates in photography are acceptable. MUST be able to provide proof of education and verifiable documentation showing what courses were completed and what the final grades were.
  • Hands on experience in professional photography is preferred and must be documented and provable:
  • A website or online portfolio that showcases the candidate’s work is preferred.
  • All work MUST be verifiable as their own original work.
  • A printed portfolio (in case a face‑to‑face interview is required) is preferred, and must be verifiable as the candidate’s original work.

  • Intermediate to advanced Windows or Mac‑based computer skills, proficient in Microsoft Office applications, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or similar types of programs.
  • Photo Equipment: Nikon DSLR systems, Nikon Flash Systems, Hensel & Godox Studio Flash Systems, and related accessories. Fuji Frontier, Noritsu, and Epson commercial grade printing equipment experience preferred.

Language

Effective communication is a critical part of this job. Photo staff must be able to interact with guests in a positive, upbeat style and therefore they MUST BE FLUENT (or close to fluent) in English and be an effective communicator.

Personality

Personable communicator with outstanding social skills and a warm, friendly, and engaging personality. Ability to continuously surprise and delight guests throughout their cruise experience. Commitment to establish and maintain courteous and professional working relationships in a diverse cultural environment.

Job Benefits

  • A competitive salary package.
  • Your comfortable double cabin — your space to relax and recharge.
  • Company‑paid travel to and from the ship, so you can focus on the journey ahead.
  • Access to exclusive areas and benefits onboard (depending on the rank and occupational group).
  • A vibrant recreation and welfare program designed to support your well‑being and work‑life balance.
  • Access to exceptional learning and development opportunities to grow your skills and advance your career.
  • The chance to travel the world, exploring exciting destinations while doing what you love.
